 BTS wins big!
 TPO - BTS achieved the biggest win at the Melon Music Awards 2026 (MMA 2026), taking home six awards, including two important Daesang awards: Artist of the Year and Album of the Year.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 16/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On November 15th, BTS further solidified their leading position in Kpop by winning three awards on the second night of the MMA 2026 awards ceremony: Artist of the Year, Top 10, and Best Male Group.
 Earlier, on the first night of the show on November 14th, the group received three awards: Album of the Year, Stage of the Year, and Global Top 10.
 With a total of six awards, BTS became the most honored artist at this year's awards ceremony. According to The Korea JoongAng Daily , this is the fourth time the group has won Artist of the Year at the MMA. 
 The album Arirang , released in March 2026, marks BTS's comeback after three years and nine months since their last studio album.
 The title track "Swim" quickly topped the Melon Top 100 chart just one hour after its release. All 14 songs on the album entered the chart. Internationally, the album and the title single also topped the US Billboard 200 and Billboard Hot 100 charts, respectively.
 You may also like Due to their ongoing world tour, all seven members were unable to attend the awards ceremony in person. The group sent their thanks to fans through a pre-recorded video.
 Suga shared that 2026 will be an unforgettable time for BTS and the Army community. Meanwhile, Jimin recalled the joy of the group meeting their fans again after a long hiatus. Jungkook also expressed his desire to share the joy of victory with his fans.
 Besides BTS, many other artists also made their mark at MMA 2026. The girl group IVE won five awards, including the Daesang for Song of the Year with their song "Bang Bang ," a pre-release track from their second studio album, "Revive+ ." The boy group Cortis received the Daesang for Record of the Year, along with two awards for Top 10 and Global Top 10. This was Cortis' first time winning the Daesang at MMA.
 Meanwhile, aespa became the first recipient of the Global-K Artist of the Year award, a new category introduced this year to recognize the influence of K-pop artists in South Korea , China, and Japan. 
 You may also like IVE, Cortis, and aespa all won at MMA 2026. MMA 2026 marks the 18th edition of the awards ceremony and the first time it has spanned two days, taking place at the Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul. According to The Korea Herald , the event brought together 26 artists and groups performing, presenting awards in 29 categories, and attracting approximately 36,000 attendees over the two days.
 BTS winning two important Daesang awards shows that the group's appeal remains strong even after a period of collective hiatus. In particular, their victory at the MMA 2026 further solidified Arirang 's position in this year's K-pop music scene and marked a new chapter in the seven-member group's comeback journey.
